text: A topological space (X, τ) requires τ (the collection of open sets) to satisfy:
choices: X and ∅ are open; finite unions and arbitrary intersections are open
X and ∅ are open; arbitrary unions and finite intersections are open
explanation: Topology axioms: ∅,X ∈ τ; arbitrary unions of opens are open; finite intersections of opens are open.
